text:
Anya: Quick check  I put together a notify-preview variant that uses a grid so pills wrap visually without changing DOM order. Prototype: https://figma.com/file/notify-grid. Can folks scan for keyboard and SR issues?

Noah: Looks promising. Two things: 1) long translated names still overflow the grid cell and push the tooltip off-screen, 2) focus order is better but when a pill opens the suppression drawer focus doesn't land inside the drawer reliably.

Sam: For tooltips on truncated names use `aria-describedby` to reference a hidden verbose label so SR reads full name. For the drawer, add `focusTrap=true` and programmatically focus the first form control (duration) on open; on close, return focus to the originating pill.

Irene: Copy nit: we call the action "Snooze notifications" elsewhere but this mock says "Mute". Let's standardize to "Snooze". Also the suppressed state should be labeled "Suppressed by schedule" (not "Muted").

Anya: Will change copy. Accessibility bot: any automated checks to run before dev handoff?

A11y-bot: Checklist: ensure DOM order matches keyboard order (grid ok), pills have role="button" and aria-pressed when toggled, truncated labels exposed via aria-describedby, suppression drawer uses focus-trap and restores focus, add `aria-live="polite"` for user-triggered messages ("Snoozed Slack for 1h"), run axe + NVDA pass, and ensure pill contrast >=4.5:1. Also batch live announcements if multiple channels update.
